name: Layered architecture
description: Harness-owned dependency direction for presentation, application, domain, infrastructure and shared layers.

rules.title: Presentation depends inward
rules.summary: Presentation may depend on application, domain and shared code, but not infrastructure implementation details.

rules.title: Application depends on domain and shared
rules.summary: Application orchestration must not depend on presentation or concrete infrastructure layers.

rules.title: Keep the domain independent
rules.summary: Domain code must not depend on presentation, application orchestration or infrastructure implementation layers.

rules.title: Infrastructure implements inward contracts
rules.summary: Infrastructure may depend on domain/shared contracts but must not depend on presentation or application orchestration.

sources.title: Agentic Harness layered architecture pattern
sources.notes: Harness-owned dependency-direction contract. Projects can select other profiles or declare explicit scoped exceptions when this model does not fit.
